step.goal: Determine current stage and load validation criteria
step.action: Load the stage-gate rules for the current stage

gate.criteria: aidlc-state.md exists and project type is set
All questions in requirements-questions.md are answered (no empty [Answer]: tags)
Each requirement is traceable to user value
stories.md exists with user stories in Given/When/Then format
personas.md exists if multiple user types identified
Each story maps to at least one requirement
Each stage shows EXECUTE or SKIP with rationale
Each NFR requirement has a technical solution mapped
All story tasks are marked complete
Dev Agent Record is filled in story file
File List is complete in story file
All generated tests execute without environment errors
Test report is generated with pass/fail breakdown
Code bugs are flagged and tracked

step.goal: Validate each criteria for the current stage
step.action: For each criteria in the current stage gate:
- Check if the criteria is met
- Record PASS or FAIL with evidence

check.output:
**STAGE GATE: PASSED**
All {{total_count}} criteria met. Ready to proceed.
> **WHAT'S NEXT?** > 1. Approve and Continue to {{next_stage}} > 2. Review artifacts before approving

**STAGE GATE: NOT PASSED**
{{pass_count}}/{{total_count}} criteria met. Issues found:
{{failing_criteria}}
> **OPTIONS:** > 1. Fix issues and re-validate > 2. Override gate (will be logged in audit trail) > 3. Go back to {{current_stage}} to address gaps

step.action: Log validation result to audit trail
